e7f5ad81c345.question: Paper claim Theorem 1.1 (theorem-1.1) states: “For every viscosity $\nu \in \mathbb{R}$ on the 3-torus $\mathbb{T}^3 = \mathbb{R}^3/\mathbb{Z}^3$, \textbf{(Q$_1$)} spatial $\mathbb{Z}^3$-periodicity is equivalent to invariance under the three uni…”. Its title is “Master Product Theorem: \texttt{fefferman\_periodic\_ns\_exact\_reduction\_product\_theorem}”, which does not appear to describe that statement. Is the title or the statement misworded?
e7f5ad81c345.answer: harmless wording: the title is the Lean declaration name fefferman_periodic_ns_exact_reduction_product_theorem, which exists (FeffermanClayNS/FinalProductTheorem.lean:447) and whose statement is the conjunction Q1 ∧ … ∧ Q5 that the paper lists.
